| # VDD5_S3530 ECU internal reference voltage {#vdd5_s3530-ecu-internal-reference-voltage-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}                                             |                                                                                                                                                            |
+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

The cyclic check of the ECU internal voltage VDD5_S3530 via analog feedback.

## Remarks: {#remarks .p_Heading2 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

- Monitoring of overvoltage and undervoltage for error.

- Only Errors are indicated.

- Over Voltage Error Limit = 5.40V

- Under Voltage Error Limit = 4.60V

- If the VDD5_S3530 is less than 4.60V for more than 40msec of duration then the Under Voltage Error for Long time will be set.

- Refer [Safety function and safe state](safetyfunctionandsafestate.html){.topiclink} for details on the safety functions provided by the RCs and the related considerations to be observed.

- Refer [Failure detection possibilities](failuredetectionpossibilities.html){.topiclink} for a broader overview of the different failure reactions observed.

 

Error Reaction:

 

- Over Voltage Error (VDD5_S3530 \> Over Voltage Error Limit)

  Error Description              Reaction
  ------------------------------ --------------------
  DFC                            DFC_rbr_mo_OV_VDD5
  Error Code                     0x082400
  High Power Outputs(\...,OFF)   yes
  ECU Reset                      no
  Reaction time                  40ms

 

 

- Under Voltage Error (VDD5_S3530  \< Under Voltage Error Limit)

  Error Description              Reaction
  ------------------------------ --------------------
  DFC                            DFC_rbr_mo_UV_VDD5
  Error Code                     0x082500
  Error parameter                1
  High Power Outputs(\...,OFF)   yes
  ECU Reset                      no
  Reaction time                  40ms

 

- Under Voltage Error for long time

  Error Description              Reaction
  ------------------------------ --------------------
  DFC                            DFC_rbr_mo_UV_VDD5
  Error Code                     0x082500
  Error parameter                2
  High Power Outputs(\...,OFF)   yes
  ECU Reset                      yes
  Reaction time                  40ms
